title: Probe: 21 always ends a game

problem.text: Probe spec, written from the codebase (no member wrote it).

change.summary: In agent/src/vision.js, badmintonGame(a, b) counts a game as won by two clear points (22-20, and so on up to 30). The club plays every game to 21 with no setting: make 21 always end the game, so 21-20 is a finished game won by the side with 21, and no score above 21 is possible.

oracle.how: badmintonGame(21, 20).ok is true and badmintonGame(22, 20).ok is false.

privacy: No player data: a scoring rule.

title: Probe: indoor courts, one file listed

problem.text: Probe spec, written from the codebase (no member wrote it).

change.summary: Add an optional indoorOnly parameter to places.search in agent/src/places.js (default false: when true, only places that are not outdoor are returned), and to the Autopilot's find_places tool in agent/src/autopilot.js, which declares it in TOOLS as an optional boolean and passes it on to places.search.

oracle.how: find_places with indoorOnly returns indoor places only.

privacy: No player data: a filter on public places.
